verdict.statement: Does not conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
verdict.note: Findings report, not a conformance claim.

surfaces.name: Blocking failures
surfaces.note: 4 chart canvases + 2 form controls have no accessible name; keyboard, focus and flash safety pass

surfaces.name: Typography
surfaces.note: No size-floor violations; survives 1.4.12 override on all 7 pages; sizes are ad-hoc

surfaces.name: Targets & pointer
surfaces.note: 94 targets measured, none below the 24px floor

surfaces.name: Motion
surfaces.note: Flash-safe, reduced-motion honoured, but the 38s ticker has no pause control

surfaces.name: Infographics & media
surfaces.note: All four chart canvases lack a text alternative

surfaces.name: AAA headroom
surfaces.note: Reduced-motion earns credit; 7:1 contrast and 44px targets do not

methodology.tooling_gap: The wcag-audit skill synced without scripts/ and references/. No axe-core, Playwright or Node available. WCAG arithmetic reimplemented from normative formulas and self-tested: 27/27 against published reference values.
corrections: Headless Chrome clamps window width to ~500 CSS px; the first reflow pass measured 500px and reported a false pass. Redone via CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride.
Flagging animation-name != none produced 4 false reduced-motion failures; the guard zeroes duration and iteration count. Re-measured as duration x iterations.
Focus styles read immediately after .focus() returned pre-transition values (transition: border-color 0.2s). Re-measured after settling.
dismissed: /home suggestion inputs unreachable by Tab - they are inside a closed <details>; the summary is reachable. Correct pattern.
button#submit-btn measures 1.91:1 but is disabled on load; SC 1.4.3 exempts inactive components.
not_tested: Screen-reader output (NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver) - 4.1.2 assessed from DOM accessible names
1.2.x not applicable, no audio or video
Form error association inferred from source, not exercised against a live validation failure

findings.title: Chart canvases have no text alternative
findings.measured: aria_label empty, role empty, no caption, no fallback content on all four
findings.replacement: role="img" plus a generated aria-label carrying the finding, plus a visually-hidden data table

findings.title: Two form controls have no programmatic label
findings.measured: labelled: false on both; placeholder only
findings.replacement: Explicit <label for>, plus aria-describedby to tie the character counter to the textarea

findings.title: Horizontal scrolling at 320 CSS px
findings.also: At 256px (~400% zoom) / fails too, at 299px, from the .emoji-btn row
findings.replacement: overflow:hidden on .ticker-section; flex-wrap on both top bars under 420px

findings.title: Scrolling ticker cannot be paused
findings.measured: div#tickerContent runs tickerScroll 38s infinite, auto-starting, alongside other content
findings.note: The prefers-reduced-motion guard at style.css:2172 works (0 effectively-moving animations measured under the OS setting) but 2.2.2 requires an operable control, not only an OS preference
findings.replacement: A #tickerToggle button with aria-pressed toggling animationPlayState

passing.evidence: Spacing override clips 0 containers across all 7 pages
Every focusable element reached by real Tab on all 7 pages
Focus cycles through BODY and wraps; no trap
Every focused control shows an indicator; border-colour route measures 3.57:1 state change
94 targets measured, none below 24px; the one 17px element is an exempt inline link
No flashing; fastest animation is a 2s pulse
All 7 pages have unique descriptive titles
No skip link, but main landmarks + h1/h2 satisfy via H69

items.what: Give .suggestion-input/textarea the focus ring on every page; the ring block at style.css:2135 is scoped to body.admin-body/auth-body, and form.html, committee_login.html, committee_form.html and thanks.html carry no body class. #email on /committee/login measures 2.77:1 state change, below 3:1, and a 1px border misses the 2px-perimeter area requirement.
Raise body text to 7:1. 11 of 20 pairs already pass. Darkening --blue-600 to #1d5a93 takes white-on-blue from 4.84:1 to 7.04:1.
Grow targets to 44px. 17 of 94 sit below. The phi ladder from 24px is 24 -> 39 -> 63; 39px suits .segmented-btn (currently 31.2px).
Add a skip link. Already passes via H69 but cheap and helps on the dashboards.
Associate form errors with their fields: role="alert" on the banner, aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the field, move focus to the banner. Inferred from source.
